feedback: yes better. But as I said, I dislike this thing in both variants, it's not good overall, sounds like a "wanna be drum" (missing the bass)
scope: Comparative improvement in release is not acceptance of the repeated sound or groove arrangement. The listener perceives an unconvincing drum-like sound lacking bass weight.
attributionLimit: Both variants and the perceived drum do not uniquely identify a SID voice. A3 remains a hypothesis, not a confirmed source. Missing bass describes perceived weight; it does not establish absence of low score notes.
reusableLesson: A better envelope does not rescue an unwanted musical role. Judge body, low-end weight and in-context role separately from transient smoothness; when repeated cosmetic fixes fail, subtract the suspected part before adding more effects.
nextAction: One same-window subtraction diagnostic: remove repeated A3 accompaniment while preserving A2 bass and foreground; verify the change and ask whether the unwanted sound disappears.

modelAssistanceReview.reason: Explicit human rejection settles preference; controlled subtraction tests voice attribution more directly than model scoring.
